segments.description: A fully-integrated biopharmaceutical company commercializing and developing therapies for CNS disorders, immunology, infectious diseases, and rare diseases.
segments.evidence: We ("Tonix" or the "Company") are a fully-integrated biopharmaceutical company commercializing and developing innovative therapies for central nervous system ("CNS") disorders, immunology, infectious diseases, and rare diseases.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue from selling its commercial prescription products, TONMYA, Zembrace SymTouch and Tosymra, to wholesale and other third-party distributors and pharmacies.
